record.name: Fraza AI: Language Learning
record.offering: Education app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Learn a language by actually speaking it.
Fraza AI is a language learning app with an AI tutor that teaches out loud. It talks, listens, corrects you in the moment, and never gets tired of your questions.
Learn English, German, French, Italian, Spanish or Polish - from your first word to real conversations.


A COURSE BUILT FOR YOUR LEVEL: A1, A2, B1, B2
Pick a language and a level, and the app builds your lesson plan. Beginners (A1, A2) start with core vocabulary, simple phrases and their first short dialogues. Intermediate learners (B1, B2) work on complex grammar, idioms, nuance and fluency. Every lesson builds on the last one, and the plan adapts as you improve - no random exercises, no starting over.

NATURAL VOICE, PERFECT PRONUNCIATION
Every lesson is spoken with lifelike, native-quality audio. You hear how the language actually sounds - real intonation, rhythm and stress - so listening practice and pronunciation practice happen at the same time, not in separate drills.

PRACTICE MODE: REHEARSE THE CONVERSATION BEFORE YOU HAVE IT
Choose a situation and live through it in a spoken dialogue with your AI tutor:
Renting a car and dealing with the rental desk
Ordering food at a restaurant or café
Hotel check-in and airport check-in
Job interviews and work meetings
Doctor's appointments, pharmacy, emergencies
Shops, banks, taxis, train stations
Meeting new people and making small talk
You can also build any scenario yourself. Describe the situation, who you're talking to and what you want to achieve, and your tutor will play the part. Arguing with your internet provider, a first date, a customer support call, a thesis defense - anything you're nervous about, you can rehearse first.

A REAL AI TUTOR, NOT A QUIZ APP
Lessons are led by an advanced AI model. It understands context, replies like a person, and gives you instant feedback on grammar, vocabulary and pronunciation. When you make a mistake, you get an explanation - not a red X.

WHY IT WORKS
You speak out loud from lesson one - because speaking is the skill you actually want
No embarrassment: make mistakes as many times as you need, nobody is judging
You learn phrases you'll really use, not textbook sentences
Practice whenever you have ten minutes - a queue, a commute, a coffee break
Your progress is saved and your course adapts to it

HOW TO START
Choose your language: English, German, French, Italian, Spanish or Polish
Choose your level: A1, A2, B1 or B2
Get your personal lesson plan
Take lessons and practice speaking in real-life dialogues
Language learning stops feeling like homework and starts feeling like a conversation. Download Fraza AI and say your first sentence today.

Questions or ideas? Write to us at support@aifraza.com

More than 23 million learners worldwide use Lingualeo!
Lingualeo is the ultimate language-learning app — making learning English, Chinese, Czech, Dutch, French, German, Greek, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Serbian, Spanish, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese and more languages  fun, interactive, and effective.
You get personalized recommendations, exercises, and vocabulary suggestions tailored perfectly to your level.
Whether you want to improve reading, speaking, writing, or listening skills, Lingualeo provides all the tools you need to reach your goals.

Why Lingualeo Stands Out:

1. Interactive Lessons and Exercises
Read books, watch videos, and explore articles in their original language. Tap unknown words to translate and save them — expand your vocabulary naturally and in context.
Our AI also helps you find content that matches your current level.

2. Leo Chat — your personal language practice buddy
Discuss any topic. 
Easy  translate and save new words. 
The chat actively uses words from your dictionary in conversations, so you can memorize them faster and learn to use fluently in practice.

3.  Thematic and Grammar Courses
Learn with engaging clips, dialogues, and scenes from popular content. 
Improve your pronunciation, listening, and speaking skills with dynamically adaptive AI-powered exercises.

4. Games and Challenges
Play interactive mini-games, test your skills, and compete with other learners. 
Gamified exercises make learning fun and highly effective.

5. Personalized Progress Tracking
Track your progress in writing, listening, speaking, and vocabulary. 
Focus on the skills that matter most to you. Leo shows your achievements and suggests the best next steps.

6. Flexible Learning
Learn anytime, anywhere — even 5 minutes a day makes a difference. 
Lingualeo adapts to your level and pace, making it perfect for both kids and adults.


Join millions of learners worldwide and turn language learning into an exciting adventure — develop new skills, explore cultures, and learn with fun thanks to Lingualeo!

Lingualeo Premium

Auto-renewal can be turned off at any time in your iTunes Store settings.
Any unused portion of a free trial — if offered — will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

StudioAI – AI Language Learning from Your Own Content

Most language apps make you follow their content. StudioAI learns from yours.
Upload any YouTube video, PDF, or article and get AI-powered exercises — on any topic, in any language you're learning.

Studio: Learn from What You Love
Upload a PDF, YouTube video, or web article and StudioAI transforms it into AI-powered practice modes built from your own content:
- Flashcards — scheduled by FSRS at the exact moment you're about to forget, so every review counts
- Quizzes — questions from your own sources to check what you actually understood, not just what you memorized
- Podcast-style audio summaries
- Grammar Exercises: Practice grammar inside sentences that actually sound real — notice patterns, fix recurring mistakes, and apply rules more confidently
- Cloze: Complete sentences using context, not memorization — key for reading and understanding more naturally
- Dictation: Listen and write exactly what you hear
- Error Hunting: Spot grammar mistakes hidden in real sentences
- Transformations: Rewrite phrases to master grammar structures
- Word Sorting: Match collocations or classify words into semantic groups
- Micro Writing: Short writing tasks with model answers and feedback

Local AI Tutor - Private by Design
On supported iPhone and iPad models with 6GB RAM or more, chat with an AI tutor that runs entirely on your device. No server. No internet required. It knows your level, native language, and current unit to give you precise hints and explanations instantly.

StudioAI schedules every review at the exact moment you're about to forget it, so every minute of study counts.

- Face ID / Touch ID protection
- Designed for iPhone and iPad

record.description_evidence:
Sakuraspeak offers a unique, fun, and faster way to practice Japanese & Korean through conversations, designed for both language learners and travelers.  

“Speaking Japanese used to feel overwhelming whenever I needed to include specific details like dates, times, or numbers in a sentence. I’d get stuck halfway through and wasn’t sure how to connect everything properly. For instance, I wanted to say, ‘I’d like to make a dinner reservation for 2 people on Saturday at 6 pm,’ but I couldn’t figure out how to piece it all together. Thanks to Sakuraspeak, I was able to complete the sentence effortlessly. The app has been a lifesaver for those moments when I know part of what to say but need help to finish it confidently.” - Amanda D.

“Your AI product is exactly the kind of thing that I've been hoping to find and to come to exist." - Thomas, Korean language learner for 20 years

"So far I'm really liking the app. I've been using it to ask grammar questions and its been really useful. get to practice speaking and do some grammar study at the same time." - Crater

“Before using Sakuraspeak, I struggled with speaking Japanese confidently because I wasn’t sure if I was making mistakes or using the right grammar. It was frustrating not knowing how to improve. With Sakuraspeak’s correction and explanation features, everything changed. The app not only points out my mistakes but also explains them clearly, so I can learn and avoid repeating them. Thanks to Sakuraspeak, I’m building confidence in speaking Japanese and making real progress every day!” - Benjamin

Why Sakuraspeak?
  
Real-Life Conversations: Practise speaking with role-play scenarios like ordering coffee, asking for directions, or ordering food at a restaurant – perfect for everyday use and travel

AI-Powered Speaking Partner: Feel like you're talking to a real person. Our AI provides instant feedback on pronunciation, grammar, and fluency, helping you improve with every conversation.  

Daily Speaking Practice: Just 10 minutes a day! Conveniently fit SakuraSpeak into your daily routine, anytime, anywhere.  

Tailored for All Levels: Whether you’re a beginner or advanced learner, our app adapts to your pace and level.  

Key Features:
Role-Play Scenarios: Experience different situations to learn how to speak the language like a local.
Personalized Learning Paths: Tailored exercises based on your proficiency level.
Daily Practice Reminders: Stay on track with daily notifications.
Progress Tracking: Monitor your growth and celebrate your achievements.
Speak Fluently: Regular practice to build fluency and boost confidence.

At Sakuraspeak, we understand the challenges of learning a language. Our team created this app to provide an immersive, enjoyable, and effective way to learn languages. Practice speaking in realistic scenarios and feel confident wherever you go!

Ready to Start Speaking?

Try the app out today and start your journey to fluency.

How does Lola Speak help me learn English?

record.name: Mirinae - Learn Korean with AI
record.offering: Education app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
◉ Let Mirinae be your AI Korean Teacher!
You enter a Korean sentence and Mirinae will translate the sentence, show you all the individual parts of speech, find and explain any grammar patterns present, explain the particles and honorifics and verb conjugations, identify & explain any idioms or neologisms used, and draw out a parse-tree showing all the individual phrases & clauses in the sentence.

Click on anything in the explanation for more details, alternate word definitions, example uses, related patterns, cross-references to learning sites and major textbooks, and much more..

All this allows the learner to explore Korean wherever they encounter it, perhaps an example sentence in a dictionary or lesson text, some song lyrics or drama dialog, etc., and interactively discover its meaning, syntax, grammar patterns and any idioms used, and then to explore and continue learning, finding other examples of the patterns and words used.

◉ Learn while watching Kdrama or browsing the web
There is also a Chrome Extension version that lets you explore and learn from Korean text you encounter on any website, including Kdrama subtitles on streaming sites like Viki.com, Netflix and Youtube.

When enabled, the Mirinae extension will detect Korean on any web-page, so you can explore and get a deep understanding of any Korean directly within the page so that it can be very easily used to augment existing Korean teaching, reference and translation sites and video streaming sites. Visit the Chrome Store and search for “Mirinae”.

◉ Built-in Dictionary, Searchable Grammar & Idiom Reference and Grammar-term Glossary
Mirinae has a built-in dictionary & searchable grammar reference and can also be used as a deep, interactive Korean reference that is driven by examples of the things you want to search for.    The library has a large and growing number of idiom patterns and neologisms (newly-coined words), essential for understanding modern spoken Korean, Kpop lyrics and Kdrama dialog.

◉ High tech!!
Mirinae uses advanced machine learning, natural language processing and a non-deterministic phrase-structure parser, coupled with a proprietary regular-expression grammar-pattern, idiom and neologism library to build a lexical and grammatical analysis of the text, showing a breakdown of the text into its component words and particles and suffixes and other parts-of-speech along with a display of its structure in terms of phrases and predicates and clauses.

It also uses an advanced, bi-language embedding-vector meaning disambiguator to provide likely meanings for individual words in the sentence, which is not easily determined from a full sentence-translation, as you might get from a standard translation site.

■ Language Learning AI Note App
DRAWER provides a writing experience for speaking and expands your communication skills. For language learners aiming to communicate, writing is an effective method. It's currently challenging to improve or create texts. DRAWER instantly corrects your written text with AI and translates expressions you may not understand.

■ Habitual Diary Writing and Expanding Expression
It's crucial to articulate your experiences and thoughts regularly when engaging in conversations using a foreign language. While writing diaries or engaging in writing on specific topics using the language you're learning is effective, establishing a habit is difficult. DRAWER supports habit formation in diary creation and writing with mechanisms that make you want to write every day and a simple, stress-free UI.

■ Freedom to Choose Desired Languages
You can freely choose the language you want to learn, such as English, Korean, or Chinese, as well as your native language, and it optimizes for you. Based on the selected language and your native language, AI provides optimal feedback.

■ AI Correction and Translation Features
With no hassle, AI provides feedback and translation for the text you've written. The corrected content can be instantly reflected in your text with a single tap.
